newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical starts U.S. REPEL clinicals.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical starts U.S. REPEL clinicals.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said on Tuesday that it has initiated U.S. clinical trials of REPEL, the company's bioresorbable barrier film for the prevention/reduction of post-operative adhesions.
Life Medical said that its investigational device exemption application for the polymer product was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The company said that it anticipates using the results of the trials as the basis for applying for European regulatory approval.

The multi-center, randomized, controlled pilot clinical trials will run about six months and include both laparascopic (less-invasive) and laparatomy (traditional, open) gynecological surgical procedures, the company said.
If successful, REPEL could be available for sale throughout Europe during the first half of 1998, it said.
The company said that it has entered into discussions with prospective corporate partners to handle the sale and distribution of the product.
Adhesions are fibrous growths that occur at surgical sites. A bioresorbable barrier is one that the body disposes of through natural means over time.
